title: Route active shell locomotion into bridge-trajectory Pose Search

observed_failure.routing_cause: ShouldUseBridgeOwnedMovementDrive is false in LocomotionActiveShell because it is a pre-balance shell-drive predicate and rejects balance-active/transition-owned states

hypothesis: Pose Search routing must be distinct from ownership of the pre-balance movement drive. LocomotionActiveShell should use QueryPoseSearchWithBridgeTrajectory even though ShouldUseBridgeOwnedMovementDrive remains false, while standing and denied locomotion must not use that trajectory route.
single_behavior_change: Add ShouldUseBridgeTrajectoryPoseSearch and use it only in QueryPoseSearch routing. Do not change ShouldUseBridgeOwnedMovementDrive or any shell movement ownership behavior.
tdd_contract: LocomotionActiveShell routes to bridge-trajectory Pose Search.
BalanceActive_Standing does not route to bridge-trajectory Pose Search.
LocomotionActiveShellDenied does not route to bridge-trajectory Pose Search.
Existing pre-balance ShouldUseBridgeOwnedMovementDrive semantics remain unchanged.
A scripted Normal run selects a non-idle animation during at least one locomotion phase without forcing an asset by name.
next_if_supported: Recompute Normal versus ZeroActions under the locked E60 stability-cost formula.
